case_name: Staleness Adjustment Application — Aged Evidence Handling
case_description: Mega institution assessed in PUBLIC mode with strong evidence base (120+ items) but several key T1/T2 sources are >24 months old, triggering ADJ_STALENESS ceilings. Tests that staleness adjustments apply correctly (ceiling = min(raw, others) − 0.3), that non-stale evidence still scores normally, and that the assessment achieves high maturity where evidence is fresh. Also validates 0.1-increment precision scoring with quantitative metrics.

expected_outcomes.rationale: Mega institution with strong evidence base achieves high maturity. Staleness adjustments depress specific capabilities (P3C1, P3C2, P3C3, P4C4) by 0.3 each. P2 scores highest with fresh quantitative evidence. Overall high M3 to M4.

expected_pillar_scores.P1_rationale: Strong strategy disclosure (fresh 10-K); P1C2 partially constrained by stale OCC exam but offset by fresh internal governance evidence
expected_pillar_scores.P2_rationale: Strongest pillar; fresh T2/T3 evidence with quantitative metrics supporting precision scoring; minimal staleness impact
expected_pillar_scores.P3_rationale: Stale T1 evidence (OCC exam 30mo, CFPB 28mo) triggers ADJ_STALENESS on multiple capabilities; reduces scores by ~0.3 each
expected_pillar_scores.P4_rationale: Mixed: P4C4 affected by stale OCC exam (ADJ_STALENESS); P4C1 and P4C3 have fresh evidence supporting M3-M4 scores

expected_staleness_adjustments.rationale: Each stale T1 source (>24mo) triggers ADJ_STALENESS ceiling = min(raw, others) − 0.3

expected_precision_scores.description: At least 3 subcaps should use 0.1-increment precision scoring (e.g., 3.7, 4.1, 4.3) justified by quantitative metrics from evidence

test_tolerances.rationale: Tighter category tolerance reflects stronger evidence base; staleness ceiling is mathematical and should be near-exact

regression_test_gate.test_case_purpose: Verify assessment skill handles stale evidence correctly: (1) Identifies evidence >24 months as stale, (2) Applies ADJ_STALENESS ceiling formula correctly, (3) Logs all staleness adjustments in Caps_Applied_Log with Trigger_Evidence, (4) Does NOT apply staleness to capabilities with fresh-only evidence, (5) Supports 0.1-increment precision scoring with quantitative justification
pass_criteria: Overall score falls within expected range (3.5–4.2)
ADJ_STALENESS applied to capabilities supported by stale evidence (≥3 adjustments)
No ADJ_STALENESS on capabilities with only fresh evidence
≥3 subcaps use 0.1-increment scoring with quantitative justification in rationale
Caps_Applied_Log entries for ADJ_STALENESS include Trigger_Evidence IDs
